No value-selected person/parcel deletion; absent geometry or inactive signals remain accounted for. Structural gate observed all20 same50x59x50x168 grid/affine, int8 stored BOLD with source scaling, zooms4/4/4/1 and unknown spatial/temporal units; selected15 confounds finite; all400 transferred parcels nonempty. Source bytes, not these observations, authenticate inputs. Raw header time zoom1 is not silently substituted for operationalTR2.

software_reference.brainspace: 0.1.20 historical algorithm context, not its nonsymmetric eigsh operator

spatial_extraction.resample: Source atlas label image to each source BOLD grid. Reference transform scipy.linalg.inv(atlas_affine) @ bold_affine, exact equal-grid shortcut; scipy.ndimage.affine_transform order0, modeconstant,cval0,prefilterFalse. Atlas image only, not BOLD interpolation.
spatial_extraction.support: All voxel centres on the BOLD grid with the resulting source integer parcel ID; ascending C-flat voxel index. No implicit brain mask/smoothing/nearest rescue.
spatial_extraction.empty_parcel: Keep source ID and zero voxel count; raw/clean/FC dependent values undefined with explicit mask; do not substitute zero signal or shrink the400-parcel estimator.
spatial_extraction.amendment: Explicit float64 voxel averaging replaces implicit decoded-dtype label mean.

cleaning.missing: Selected15 columns must be finite at every retained frame; no imputation or censoring. Other original columns retained as metadata but unused.
cleaning.detrend: For each signal/confound column remove float64 temporal mean, then project out v=(arange(T)-mean(arange(T)))/sqrt(sum(v_unscaled^2)). Original exact-constant columns are represented as exact zero.
cleaning.confound_scaling: After detrending center again; divide by population SD (ddof0), with SD<eps64 replaced by1; exact constants zero.
cleaning.projection: Pivoted economic QR of standardized confounds; retain Q columns whose abs(diag(R))>100*eps64. Y_nobp=Y_detrended-Q@(Q.T@Y_detrended). No final z-score.
cleaning.bp: Y_bp=sosfiltfilt(butter(5,[.01,.1],btype='bandpass',fs=.5,output='sos'),Y_nobp,axis=0,padtype='odd',padlen=33). This is separate filtering AFTER regression, not joint data/confound filtering.
cleaning.order: Both all20 and half configurations reuse the same no-band-pass subject preprocessing; no re-fitting nuisances per subgroup.
cleaning.activity: Canonical person/arm/parcel is active iff geometry exists and centeredL2(clean_arm)>1e-12*sqrt(T)*max(1,raw_sample_SD). raw_sample_SD is the centered original raw-mean sample SD (ddof1), exactconstant raw gives0; the same original raw scale is used for both arms. Centering uses accurately summed math.fsum/T, exactconstant guard and scaled Euclidean norm. Record raw_sample_sd, clean_centered_l2 and activity_threshold. This prospective numerical-resolution rule prevents nuisance-projection roundoff from manufacturing FC; it is not outcome-selected QC. Keep all people/parcels and propagate undefined support.
cleaning.constant_policy: Pearson is computed only on source-canonical active vectors, with no epsilon added to its denominator. Submitted rounded signals cannot change the canonical support mask.

connectivity.canonical: Float64 np.corrcoef(Y.T) on source-canonical active columns; retain upper-triangle values and mirror exactly; active diagonal1; inactive rows/columns explicit NaN with false parcel validity. No nan_to_num, rectification or zero imputation.
connectivity.group: For each configuration, average each complete source-canonical subject FC entry in frozen participant order (float64 NumPy mean), then mirror upper triangle and active diagonal1. Any missing/inactive participant-parcel invalidates that parcel for this complete group; no contributor omission.
connectivity.computational_authority: Canonical source-derived raw means, cleaned vectors, support and FC govern all spectral operators. Submitted raw/clean/FC arrays are source-close receipts only, never re-cleaned/rethresholded to establish the operator.

affinity.selection: Keep exactly40 largest SIGNED FC values out of400 candidates including diagonal eligibility; ties choose smaller source parcel ID. All other entries zero. Diagonal not inserted again or forcibly preserved against the tie order. This corrects floating int((1-.9)*400)=39.
affinity.row_normalization: Divide sparsified row by Euclidean norm; zero norm invalid operator.
affinity.kernel: W_ij=1-arccos(clip(dot(unit_sparse_row_i,unit_sparse_row_j),-1,1))/pi; symmetric upper mirrored, diagonal1. No preselection absolute value or positive-only pruning.
affinity.symmetric_operator: S_ij=Walpha_ij/(sqrt(d_i)*sqrt(d_j)); compute upper triangle and mirror exactly, not an additional averaging operation. Solve real symmetric problem, not eigsh on nonsymmetric D^-1 Walpha. Positive finite degrees required.
affinity.amendment: Prospectively corrects BrainSpace0.1.20 nonsymmetric-eigensolver use and largest-magnitude selection to the symmetric operator's largest algebraic nontrivial modes; not bitwise replication of that implementation.

diffusion.order: Largest algebraic eigenvalues after the stationary mode, descending; retain10, compute11th for boundary diagnostic. No largest-magnitude substitution.
diffusion.stationary: u0=sqrt(d)/sqrt(sum(d)), stationary eigenvalue1; canonical source symmetric solver establishes nontrivial eigenvalues.
diffusion.coordinate: G_ik=(U_ik/u0_i)*lambda_k/(1-lambda_k). Canonical source lambda values determine scaling; serialized lambda is a tolerance-bound receipt, not a new scaling input.
diffusion.raw_sign: For each diffusion coordinate choose the largest absolute G entry, exact ties smaller parcelID; flip U and G together so that anchor is nonnegative. All-zero coordinate uses +1. A constant g1 has explicit constant_coordinate status/null endpoints; other finite constant coordinates may be reported as constant-valued means without an additional categorical status.
diffusion.basis_equivalence: Any ordered orthonormal residual-valid basis within unresolved repeated retained eigenvalue blocks is accepted. No canonical eigenvector correlation or hidden basis gate; no arbitrary rotation mixing separated eigenvalues.
diffusion.undefined: Any invalid400-parcel FC prevents its embedding. Non-simple stationary mode or 1-lambda1<=4e-8 gives multiscale_singular. Gap(lambda1,lambda2)<=4e-8 gives principal_degenerate, so g1 endpoint/apex is null. Gap(lambda10,lambda11)<=4e-8 gives retained_boundary_degenerate, disabling full10 GPA for dependent quantities without deleting people. Finite spectral diagnostics retained.
diffusion.precision_scope: Residual and serialization envelopes do not guarantee endpoint stability near an eigenvalue gap, sparsity cutoff, zero norm or sign/apex tie.

alignment.subjects: All20 no-band-pass source embeddings; none omitted.
alignment.initial_reference: Accepted unoriented nobp_all group diffusion embedding, raw largest-absolute sign convention.
alignment.rotation: At each iteration C_i=G_i.T@old_reference; R_i orthogonal minimizes ||G_i R_i-old_reference||F. Certify maxabs(R_i.T R_i-I)<=1e-7 and nuclear_norm(C_i)-trace(R_i.T C_i)<=1e-7*max(1,nuclear_norm(C_i)); no secret SVD rotation.
alignment.update: Align ORIGINAL raw subject G_i using this iteration's R_i; new_reference=mean_i(G_i@R_i) in frozen participant order. new_dist=sum((old_reference-new_reference)^2). dist starts infinity. Stop when prior dist finite and abs(new_dist-dist)<1e-5, else update dist; cap10.
alignment.history: Store each rotation, reference and distance. Verifier recomputes reference history/stopping from accepted spectral vectors, canonical lambda and certified rotations; rounded stored history is evidence only.
alignment.undefined: If any required embedding lacks complete valid10-dimensional retained support, no GPA/mean-aligned/after-alignment consistency; preserve explicit nulls/status. Lower internal degeneracies alone do not invalidate alignment.
alignment.scope: An aligned coordinate is a rotated multicomponent coordinate, not necessarily the individual's eigenvector1. Mean aligned coordinates differ from embedding a group-mean FC.

summaries.group_orientation: For the4 mean-FC embeddings orient reported g1 so mean(Default)>=mean(Vis); equality leaves raw sign. Other9 coordinates retain raw sign. For mean aligned coordinates apply this rule separately to all10. Preserve unoriented raw embeddings and explicit signs. If a group principal coordinate is degenerate or constant, its displayed g1/network means/apex/bottom are undefined while other finite coordinates remain reported. The aligned_mean g1 requires both a defined nobp_all reference principal coordinate AND its own nonconstant across-parcel vector; otherwise null endpoints, with constant_coordinate for its own constant when the reference is valid. This does not invalidate its complete10-D GPA or other finite aligned_mean coordinates. Leading-plane B/W can remain defined when its two-dimensional span is resolved.
summaries.networks: All7 original network labels; arithmetic unweighted parcel mean within each network for every coordinate. Configurations.csv has35 rows. Source parcel membership is exact.
summaries.apex_bottom: Largest/smallest reported network mean_g1, ties in declared network order. Undefined principal/support -> null, never impose Default apex or any other network.
summaries.between_within: Descriptive leading-plane ratio: B=sum_d variance_ddof0({network mean_gd},d=1,2); W=mean_network(sum_d variance_ddof0(parcel_gd within network,d=1,2)); each variance is exactly0 when all its entries equal, otherwise float64 np.var(ddof0). This exactconstant guard applies both across network centres and within each network; no numerical threshold is added. Network centres use float64 np.mean. B/W only if W>0 and leading plane supported. Zero W ->null/status, no >1.2 threshold. Gap(lambda2,lambda3)<=4e-8 marks group leading-plane ambiguity; internal lambda1/lambda2 tie alone does not destroy the2D span.
summaries.consistency: Signed Pearson across400 parcel values for component1 for all190 unordered subject pairs, separately raw and aligned. Arithmetic pair means; per-person means use all19 partners. Complete undefined propagation; no required gain and no abs(r). Raw g1 undefined if any dependent principal axis unresolved; aligned g1 requires valid full GPA and resolved reference principal coordinate.
summaries.robustness: principal_gradient_identity_robust is Boolean equality of all4 defined apex labels; if any apex undefined return null/status. No required true/false.
summaries.aggregate_authority: Source binding first; then regenerate G, GPA/history, network/scalar summaries from the accepted certified spectral vectors/rotations. No separate hidden expected apex/consistency answer gate. Descriptive group orientation/apex uses these recomputed coordinates, not rounded CSV means.

tolerances.identity: IDs, masks, source bytes, member counts, statuses, config membership, iteration count, labels exact; nonBoolean integral numeric axes accepted. Raw/eigen arrays require enough precision for all stated certificates.
